title: Motor-imagery protocol classification with fixed calibration
scientific_question: How accurately can permitted EEG observations classify the recorded right-versus-left cued motor-imagery protocol under the first 20 same-session offline calibration-label allowance, relative to fixed context, permutation and calibration controls?
primary_outputs: Source protocol class right=1/left=0 for each of the 10,800 unique online trials, independently joined by the private generation/key mapping.

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.
This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

primary.name: target20/EEG person-macro session-macro balanced accuracy
primary.aggregation: Mean left/right recall for each100-trial session; equal two-session mean per person, then equal mean across54 people. p_right>=0.5 predicts right.
primary.rationale: Directly measures the intended recorded protocol-class target under the specific20-label condition without selective participant omission.

secondary: Binary log loss floored at1e-15, all 12 setting/arm outcomes and per-person results.
Paired EEG-minus-context, EEG-minus-permuted, calibration20-minus-zero,100-minus20 and same-minus-other-session20 balanced-accuracy differences.
Candidate versus independent probability reference; adaptive generic-tools, decoder-assisted and decoder-alone results require separately executed matched conditions.

comparators.name: Independent prospective CSP/logvariance/shrinkage-LDA/Platt reference
comparators.inputs: Exactly20or100target calibration examples when available, otherwise10,600donor trials; train-only folds.
comparators.procedure: Freeze regularized generalized-eigen CSP/four extreme filters, ddof1logvariance, sklearn lsqr shrinkageauto equal-prior LDA, fivefold out-of-fold Platt map then refit. Support failures use (n_right+.5)/(n+1); numerical errors abstain. This source has not been fitted and differs from native MATLAB/BBCI.

comparators.name: CONTEXT and PERMUTED_EEG
comparators.inputs: Same query IDs and calibration policies; context-only features or deterministic within-person/session shuffled training labels.
comparators.procedure: Run unchanged learner/reference under each declared arm; permutation is a diagnostic, not a population p-value.

comparators.name: Supplied decoder alone and adaptive model plus decoder
comparators.inputs: Same current query and training-derived bank as generic adaptive analysis; immutable fitted decoder added only in named decoder condition.
comparators.procedure: Freeze exact decoder/model/tool/runtime first; compare within matched input/compute conditions. No executed comparison is claimed.

evaluation.uncertainty: Person-level SD/sqrt54 in current scorer is descriptive; shared donors and reused trials invalidate treating conditions as independent replication or this SE as a calibrated population interval.
evaluation.failure_policy: Validate every one of 1,296 condition outputs,100ordered probabilities each, before protected target loading. Preserve explicit abstentions; any abstention leaves the whole panel unscored with zero target callbacks. Missing/extra/nonfinite/boolean or reordered responses fail.
